updates.note: Management reiterated high-teens growth in management fee income.
updates.quote: We expect management fee income to grow in the high-teens reinforcing both profitability and cash generation.

updates.note: Management reiterated confidence in double-digit revenue growth for FY26 and FY27.
updates.quote: Collectively these levers give us confidence in delivering double digit revenue growth in FY’26 and FY’27

updates.note: Management stated they plan to spend approximately INR 1,000 crores in CAPEX.
updates.quote: approximately INR 1,000 crores in CAPEX, which includes routine and new, and also renovation or expansion.

new_promises.statement: Acquisition of Brij expected to be completed by March 31, 2026.
new_promises.quote: acquisition is expected to be completed by March 31, 2026.
new_promises.speaker: Puneet Chhatwal

new_promises.statement: Atmantan is projected to generate approximately INR 100 crores in revenue in FY27.
new_promises.quote: This property and this brand is projected to generate revenue of approximately INR 100 crores in FY’27
new_promises.speaker: Puneet Chhatwal

new_promises.statement: Brij is projected to contribute approximately INR 100 crores in FY27.
new_promises.quote: This will also contribute approximately INR 100 crores in FY’27
new_promises.speaker: Puneet Chhatwal

new_promises.statement: Strategic acquisitions (ANK, Pride, Brij, Atmantan) expected to contribute INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores to consolidated topline in FY27.
new_promises.quote: expected to contribute meaningfully in the range of INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores to IHCL's consolidated topline in FY’26-‘27.
new_promises.speaker: Puneet Chhatwal

new_promises.statement: IHCL expects 60 plus hotel openings in FY27.
new_promises.quote: driven by 60 plus openings. Yes, ladies and gentlemen, 60 plus openings in FY’27
new_promises.speaker: Puneet Chhatwal

new_promises.statement: Ginger and new business verticals expected to deliver 25% plus revenue growth.
new_promises.quote: Ginger and our new business verticals are expected to deliver 25% plus revenue growth
new_promises.speaker: Puneet Chhatwal
